question: An enterprise with several AWS Regions is reviewing several independent production requirements. options.A: A workload needs to compare multiple hyperparameter combinations automatically

options.C: A workload needs to register a validated model version for controlled promotion

targets.3: Precision, recall, or an area-under-curve metric selected for the business objective

explanation:
